en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Everything's back to normal...
Even the wax effigies are gone.

<CLT=cltMIND>But Angie, Tenko...and Kiyo...
are still dead.

<CLT=cltMIND>These monitors are everywhere,
but I don't see any cameras.

<CLT=cltMIND>How is the mastermind behind this
killing game monitoring us?

<CLT=cltMIND>Or...are we not really
being watched at all?
<CLT=cltMIND>But they didn't have <CLT=cltSTRONG>traces of a soul<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltSTRONG>A soul<CLT=cltNORMAL> desperate to live,
struggling, fighting for life...
<CLT=cltMIND>That's something that can never be replicated.
